summary: The statement and proof are correct. The midpoint pushforwards have the claimed masses, support, densities, log-concavity, and centroids. The endpoint indicator inequality together with the source-capacity bounds proves simultaneous halfspace domination without double charging. Applying the accepted discrete centerpoint fact to the weighted midpoint measure yields a lattice point in the convex hull of the midpoint atoms; the affine centroid interpolation places the corresponding lifted point in C. Restricting an ambient halfspace to midpoint fibers and applying the accepted log-concave centroid-halfspace bound componentwise gives the stated constant, including vertical, boundary, empty, and whole-space cases.
